name: 98134 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98134 (Seattle) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98134 (Seattle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98134 (Seattle) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
